tagline.en_US: An application for launching HTML5 Network Speed Test Server. You can test download & upload speed from any device within your network with a web browser that is IE10 or new.

description.en_US: OpenSpeedTest is an open-source HTML5 network performance estimation tool designed for self-hosted environments. It allows users to test download speeds, upload speeds, and ping latency from any device with a modern web browser. Built purely with static assets and standard web APIs, it operates without third-party frameworks, plugins, or client-side software.
